name: Rubén Deicas
description: '''Rubén Héctor Deicas''' (born 28 January 1952), also known professionally as '''Cacho Deicas''', is an Argentine musician and singer. He was a member of the [[cumbia]] band [[Los Palmeras]] from 1978 to 2025, when he began his solo career. He is known as one of the most famous and legendary vocalists of cumbia from Santa Fe.
